description: This bar chart illustrates the effect of different model and regularization combinations across three tags. The horizontal axis represents the categories “case”, “gender”, and “number”, with labels in alphabetical order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and represents a linear scale ranging from -2 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. For each tag, there are six bars representing the effect for each of the following model/regularization combinations: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light orange), and XLM-B2 (dark red). Each bar includes error bars extending above and below the bar height. For the “case” tag, the bars range in height from approximately 1 (mBERT-R2) to 12 (XLM-B2). For the “gender” tag, the bars range from approximately 1 (mBERT-R2) to 5 (XLM-L2). For the “number” tag, the bars range from approximately 1 (mBERT-R2) to 3 (XLM-B2). No bars are visually emphasized.
